    • getNextId

      private static int getNextId(String tableName) throws SQLException
      Adds new menu items to the manager menu items in the table for the manager GUI menu panel.
      Parameters:
      frame - The loading application frame for menu items.
      Returns:
      nothing; Changes SQL database and runs loadMenuItems() to update the table.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if there is an error while getting next free id number, while adding a menu item, while attempting rollback to prior state after an error occurs.
